title: Difficult Diamond Gear
description: A simple datapack to make diamond gear harder to obtain.
body:
## **What is Difficult Diamond Gear?**
Difficult Diamond Gear is a simple datapack that changes the recipes for diamond armor & tools to require diamond blocks instead of diamonds.

This way, obtaining the best gear feels like a reward, because it takes significant effort to complete the full set of diamond armor. This levels the game's progression and makes the early game more enjoyable.
